text:
lucy: Proposal: "gated snapshots" for runtime config merges. idea: when a PR merges to config-main, instead of immediate global apply, we create an immutable snapshot and run a gated-preview against live routing for signal checks. only after snapshot passes gates do we flip active.

arjun: how is this different from previews we've discussed?

lucy: couple diffs: (1) snapshot = exact commit + compiled routing plan (no later drift), (2) preview runs deterministically against a stored sampling seed and returns a signed snapshot_report that is reusable, (3) merge is decoupled from activation so we have a stable id to reference in audits and reruns.

meera: API sketch: POST /snapshots/create {git_sha, compiled_plan} -> snapshot_id. then POST /snapshots/{id}/gated-run {sample_pct:1, cohorts:["alpha"], redaction:"mask"} -> returns gated_run_id and signed_report_url.

arjun: telemetry contract? what do we require in signed_report?

lucy: signed_report_v1: {snapshot_id, gated_run_id, sample_seed, per_route: [{route_id, baseline_p95_ms, run_p95_ms, err_delta_pp, cost_delta_per_1k, truncation_rate}], overall_score, suggested_action}. signed and HMACed by service key.

meera: make overall_score 0-100 and also include a compact_reason list so console can show the top 2 regression signals.

arjun: idempotency: gated_run_id must be stable for the same snapshot_id+seed. we should save the seed in ledger so re-fetch yields same sample.

lucy: agreed. gated_run_id = HMAC(snapshot_id + seed). rerun allowed but creates a new gated_run entry with rerun_id; original remains immutable.

ops-bot: checklist: add RBAC scopes snapshots.create, snapshots.run, snapshots.promote; telemetry schema snapshots_gated_v1; ledger append on create/run/promote/rollback. tests: deterministic sampling and HMAC idempotency.

meera: enforcement semantics: during gated-run we do "mirror & control": mirror X% of live requests to a shadow path that resolves using the snapshot routing plan, but enforce a control token bucket so shadow exec doesn't swell resource usage. production path unaffected.

arjun: privacy: mirrored payloads must follow redaction_level. default mask body, keep headers. support an org override only if approved.

lucy: promotion API: POST /snapshots/{id}/promote {mode: "staged"|"immediate", stages: [{pct, duration_mins, regions}], auto_abort_thresholds: {p95_ms:10, err_pp:0.5, cost_delta:5}}. promote returns a promotion_id and per-stage telemetry hooks.

meera: console UX: show timeline with snapshot_create -> gated_run -> signed_report (download) -> promote. each stage shows compact_score + per-route micrographs. include per-route promote/skip in UI for partial rollouts.

arjun: automation: allow a CI job to call /snapshots/{id}/promote with auto_abort_thresholds set from org policy. if thresholds breached, system auto-pause and notify \@oncall plus create a ledger event with suggested rollback token.

lucy: audit tokens: any promotion returns a promotion_token that must be supplied to emergency rollback endpoint for verification. tokens are short-lived and logged in ledger with actor.

ops-bot: note: add an e2e harness that can replay a synthetic baseline and then apply a synthetic regression to assert auto_abort. add unit tests for signed_report verification.

arjun: one nit: keep signed_report URL short-lived and also store a ledger copy for compliance export.

meera: sounds solid. i'll draft RFC with telemetry schema examples and a small PoC that returns a signed_report for a deterministic sample. aiming to PR by tomorrow.

lucy: thanks — will wire console mocks after PoC. :white_check_mark:
